prompt: Which workspace has a member named Morgan who's been posting about the server migration timeline slipping into next quarter? I want to loop that person into our cross-team infra sync.
binding_note: The identifying chain is WORKSPACE→WORKSPACE_MEMBERSHIP→USER→MESSAGE: a workspace member whose first name is Morgan and who personally authored a message about the migration-timeline slippage. Two different users named Morgan in two different workspaces each satisfy this chain (one in Test Workspace, one in Nimbus Robotics), so the workspace referent is unresolved without further disambiguation. A third Morgan (Morgan Freeman) is a workspace member but never posts about the topic, and a non-Morgan user posting about the same topic does not satisfy the 'member named Morgan' condition.
